page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.3xlarge belongs to the High Clock Speed instance family, built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. The server is powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor clocked at a baseline of 3.1 GHz, featuring 6 physical cores and 12 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. It is configured with 48.0 GB of memory, providing a balanced 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware vector instruction sets including AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI are available for vectorized computational tasks.

The hardware configuration does not bundle local storage disks or dedicated GPUs, relying entirely on remote cloud storage options and standard host networking. Network performance is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. Memory subsystem benchmarks show high caching throughput, delivering 642.07 GB/sec for small 16 KB read blocks and 72.53 GB/sec uncached read throughput for 256 MB blocks, accompanied by write speeds of 43.69 GB/sec.

Benchmark results place the ecs.hfg6.3xlarge squarely in the middle 50% across most standard computational and enterprise metric categories. It achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 6470.0 and a single-core score of 1290.0, with PassMark measuring CPU performance at 13063.41 and memory performance at 2534.54. In application-focused metrics, it sustained 11.25 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 10.16 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. Natural language inference tests showed average generation speeds for lightweight 135M parameter models at 165.49 tokens/sec, but processing degraded to weak tier performance for 7B parameter models at 17.47 prompt tokens/sec.

Due to the balanced ratio of dedicated compute to memory and a lack of onboard storage, this server is suitable for mid-sized general workloads that demand stable processor frequencies without physical accelerator hardware. Key target workloads include web application serving, backend microservices, caching tiers like Redis, build pipelines, and relational database systems utilizing external network storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.3xlarge is a high clock speed, general-purpose server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture and KVM virtualization, it provides 12 dedicated vCPUs across 6 physical cores, 48.0 GB of memory, and 4 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no local storage and zero GPU hardware, directing persistent disk traffic across the network interface. Synthetic benchmarks place the instance in the middle tier, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 6470.0, PassMark CPU score of 13063.41, and a static web serving rate of 10.16 GB/sec. Large language model inference remains viable for small architectures but drops in efficiency on larger 7B models. With its standard 1:4 core-to-memory allocation, it fits enterprise web serving, compilation workloads, Redis caching tiers, and standard relational database hosting.
